train.name: Aldith Fenn
facts: Has kept the night watch at the gate for eleven years.
Carves small wooden birds while on duty.
Her brother runs the ferry downriver.

train.name: Borric Hale
facts: Knows every carter who crosses the bridge by name.
Lost two fingers to frostbite one hard winter.
Plays the bone flute badly and often.

train.name: Edda Marlow
facts: Was a seamstress before she joined the watch.
Keeps a tally of every stall in the market.

train.name: Gerrit Halm
facts: Took over the post from his father.
Feeds the yard cats every morning.
Has never missed the midsummer fair.

train.name: Hesta Bryn
train.place: the edge of the pine woods near Thistlecombe
facts: Reads the weather from the flight of birds.
Sells pelts at the market twice a month.
Lives alone in a cabin she built herself.

train.name: Joss Tarn
facts: Hunts ducks with a net, never a bow.
Owes the cooper money for a new boat.
Tells the same three jokes to everyone.

train.name: Kell Rowan
facts: Tracks deer for the lord's table.
Mends his own boots and is proud of it.

train.name: Linnet Ashby
train.place: the fur stall at the Pikestead market
facts: Learned to trap from her grandmother.
Trades furs for salt and iron.
Is saving for a second mule.

train.name: Merek Dunn
facts: Served ten years on the border.
Writes letters for comrades who cannot write.
Limps a little when it rains.

train.name: Nessa Holt
train.place: the watch post on the Hollinmere road
facts: Joined the levy at sixteen.
Polishes her helmet every evening.
Wants to be made sergeant before she is thirty.

train.name: Oswin Crake
facts: Counts the days until his service ends.
Plans to open a cooperage with his pay.
Knows a marching song for every mile.

train.name: Petra Lund
facts: Trains the new recruits each spring.
Keeps a garden behind the barracks.

train.name: Rosal Venn
train.place: a cloth stall in the Thistlecombe market
facts: Buys wool upriver and sells it dyed.
Never forgets a customer's face.
Has a daughter apprenticed to a weaver.

train.name: Sim Garrow
facts: Sells candles, rope and lamp oil.
Weighs everything twice.
Inherited the shop from an uncle.

train.name: Tilda Wren
train.place: a spice cart on the Easterwell road
facts: Travels between four villages with her cart.
Haggles for the pleasure of it.
Named her mule after a queen.

train.name: Quenby Vale
facts: Sells pots made by his three sisters.
Collects river stones with holes in them.

train.name: Ulric Moss
train.place: a barley field east of Thistlecombe
facts: Farms the land his family has held for six generations.
Trusts his old ox more than any horse.
Sings to the seed when he sows.

train.name: Verity Sedge
facts: Grows apples and pears for the autumn market.
Keeps twelve beehives.
Has raised five children and two orphans.

train.name: Wat Tolly
facts: Herds the village sheep with two dogs.
Can whistle any tune after hearing it once.
Has never been farther than the next village.

train.name: Yara Thorn
train.place: a turnip plot by the Pikestead mill
facts: Took over the farm when her husband died.
Lends her plough to any neighbor who asks.

train.name: Anselm Quill
facts: Copies old land records for the steward.
Is writing a history of the valley.
Loses his spectacles at least once a day.

train.name: Brida Lorne
train.place: the herb garden of the Hollinmere almshouse
facts: Studies healing plants and keeps careful notes.
Teaches the village children their letters.
Corresponds with scholars in three cities.

train.name: Cedany Rook
train.place: the old observatory tower near Easterwell
facts: Charts the stars every clear night.
Built her own brass instruments.

train.name: Dunstan Ives
train.place: the map room of the Pikestead guildhall
facts: Draws maps of the roads and rivers.
Has walked every path he has drawn.
Stammers when he speaks to a crowd.

test.name: Evka Durn
facts: Knows which carts are late before they arrive.
Shares her post with an old hound.
Was born in the gatehouse.

test.name: Farren Oake
facts: Hunts hares with a pair of trained hawks.
Sells feathers to the fletcher.
Sleeps under the open sky all summer.

test.name: Gisla Brandt
facts: Carries the banner on parade days.
Sends half her pay home to her mother.

test.name: Hobb Tansy
test.place: a tinker's wagon in the Sorrelgate square
facts: Mends pots and sells needles and thread.
Knows the gossip of a dozen villages.
Paints his wagon a new color every spring.

test.name: Idony Culver
test.place: a flax field west of Sallowby
facts: Grows flax for the linen weavers.
Rises before dawn every day of the year.
Keeps a single very old goose.

test.name: Jorund Pell
test.place: the bell tower library in Sorrelgate
facts: Keeps the records of births and weddings.
Is teaching himself a foreign tongue.

test.name: Katrin Vasse
facts: Swore her oath to the lord of the keep four years ago.
Rides a grey mare she raised from a foal.
Has won the ring-joust twice.

test.name: Lowen Hartle
test.place: the bakehouse on mill lane in Sorrelgate
facts: Lights the ovens two hours before dawn.
Learned the trade from his aunt.
Saves the burnt loaves for the ducks.
